liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (4 reviews): Foolish Heart opened the second set, which the reviewer singled out; Reviewer calls it the best Foolish Heart, with Jerry's guitar seeming to take on a life of its own [6][9][11][15]
- **Estimated Prophet** (3 reviews): Reviewer says this was the first Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World since Brent's death; Reviewer treats the Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World as a gift for the ages [6][9][11]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Jerry plays one of his nicest solos in this Peggy-O, the reviewer's favorite version [7]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 review): Reviewer found Wang Dang Doodle a real treat, along with Brown Eyed Women [15]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Reviewer also singles out a great Brown Eyed Women [13]
- **Masterpiece** (1 review): Reviewer praises Jerry's playing and a great version of Masterpiece [13]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Jerry's guitar sits far back in the mix during Eyes [17]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Jerry stands out, giving everything in Black Peter [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Standing On The Moon Tease**: back after 205 archived shows (1042 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-09-08.112788.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 152 min [1]. Said about its sound: Digital noise is present on the DAT master, especially bad during Foolish Heart [1]
- **gd1993-09-08.28780.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 154 min; rated 3.33/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: On the soundboard, Jerry's guitar is turned way up in the first-set mix, particularly in Peggy-O; A poorly EQ'd drum causes an annoying glitch sound on this board [15][16]
- **gd93-09-08.akg.ladner.16754.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 145 min; rated 3.9/5 by 20 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the audience recording sounds like the band is playing in a cave [17]
- **gd1993-09-08.schoeps-evans.waddell.91950.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 154 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer points to a big Phil blow-out in the second set [9]
- Reviewer rates 9-10-93 as stellar and recalls a Morning Dew on 9-9-93, but still finds this night has highlights [8]
- Reviewer calls the first set average and doubts this is the best Peggy-O ever [11]
- Reviewer thinks this Peggy-O could be the best ever, with the famous Las Vegas 94 version very close [13]
- The same drum glitch appears on many 1993 soundboards, including 2/23/93 [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-09-08.112788.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; transferred by Terry Watts; source: Source: (stand/ORTF/110^/DFC/Section) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > Panasonic SV-255 > DAT(m); [1]. Also: This transfer comes from a DAT master; the second set is tracked seamlessly [1]
- **gd1993-09-08.28780.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 SBD -> Master Dat -> Dat Clone (48k) [2]
- **gd93-09-08.akg.ladner.16754.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Chris Ladner; source: Audience: AKG 491's [4]
- **gd1993-09-08.schoeps-evans.waddell.91950.flac16**: taped by Todd Evans; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Schoeps Mk4v Capsules (ORTF Cardiod) -> Schoeps KC5 Active Cable -> Schoeps CMC6 Mic Body -> Monster M1000 Jumper -> Apogee AD500e -> Casio DA-R100 DAT Deck. [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Richfield Coliseum - September 8, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/september-8-1993) [19]
